source: OECD, PISA 2025 Results (Volume I), Annex B1
source_table: StatLink mrq53f.xlsx: Tables I.B1.2a.37 (reading, 2000–), I.B1.2a.38 (mathematics, 2003–), I.B1.2a.36 (science, 2006–)
frequency: every three to four years (one-time builder; re-run on the next Volume I)
unit: PISA score points (mean) with standard errors
transformations: the 17 OECD peers plus the OECD average, OECD average-23 (the OECD's trend comparator) and OECD average-35 kept; other countries dropped
'm' (missing) cells dropped; the OECD's sampling-standards asterisk kept as `caution`
notes: PISA 2025 published 8 September 2026. Countries flagged caution=True (incl. Canada) did not meet one or more PISA sampling standards in 2025. Maintenance ritual pisa_results.
